text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of race we'll see in the fight for the Autumn Shield.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: You can feel the enthusiasm of the crowd today here at the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian! I've had high hopes for you since spring!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you! Do your best today for your sister's sake too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser! Give it your all this time! And take the win!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Keep your focus till the end! Once the race starts, there's no going back!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Th-the cheers for me seem to have a slightly different tone to them…

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text: Please just finish the race in one piece!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… I'll do my best!
Matikanetannhauser waves in response to the cheers and a harmonious laughter fills the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, what's with this lax vibe? This isn't some field day for brats!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Are they even taking this seriously?
choice_data_list: Pay it no mind and just focus.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Give me a break…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Now at the paddock, it's none other than Narita Brian!
Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: O-Ooh! She looks like a boss!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But, s-still… I have no intention of losing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: A-agh! Don't look at me with such a scary face!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I was just trying to say how I felt! I wasn't trying to start a fight or anything!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oh, she's challenging Brian to battle?! Don't get too nervous and collapse!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aha… I-I'm okay.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It seems like the fans are also worried. I always fumble things at the most important times.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But I've worked hard to get this far. Every day, I picture the faces of those I wish to defeat.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I put so much time into figuring out how to win that I don't have time to be scared.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've studied your form countless times, searching for my path to victory…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Just like… everyone else does. Hahaha, who am I kidding? I can't hope to compare to you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …You do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Only a handful of racers reach the G1. Even among those who manage to keep an unbroken spirit, this is a stage that only a chosen few can compete on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm going to bring you down with everything I've got. I've come here to seize victory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So you better come at me too… with the intent to crush me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: R-right!
